definitions.pass_attempts: Passes thrown, including spikes, excluding sacks and two-point tries.
definitions.passing_yards: Official passing yards (nflverse passing_yards; sack yardage not deducted).
definitions.passing_touchdowns: Completed passes that ended in a touchdown with no lost fumble.
definitions.epa_per_dropback: EPA / dropbacks (pass attempts plus sacks) with EPA.
definitions.rush_attempts: Official rushing attempts, including kneels and scrambles.
definitions.rushing_touchdowns: Rushes that ended in a touchdown with no lost fumble.
definitions.targets: Pass attempts (not sacks) with this player as the intended receiver.
definitions.receiving_touchdowns: Receptions that ended in a touchdown with no lost fumble.

limitations: Totals come from nflverse play-by-play and can differ from official records by a few yards when the league later corrects a play.
Touchdowns are attributed to the passer/rusher/receiver of a scoring play without a lost fumble; a touchdown after a lateral is credited to the original ball carrier.
Throwaways without an intended receiver count as pass attempts but not as targets.
Fumbles are not attributed to individual players in the stored data.
Only seasons that have been imported are available.
